quests.title: A Parcel for Sailor's House
quests.summary: Carry a brown-paper parcel to a relative in Sailor's House, then bring word back to Scouse House.

steps.text: Take the parcel to Sailor's House.
steps.line: Oh, from Scouse House? That'll be my sister's doing. A cardigan, again. Tell her I'm wearing the last one.

steps.text: Take the word back to Scouse House.
steps.line: Oh, you've been! And she's wearing it? Well. That's me told, and a tea owed to you.

start.ask: Alright, la, would you do me a kindness? There's a parcel here for my sister in Sailor's House. It's only a cardigan and a lot of string.
start.accept: Marvellous. Mind the string, it's load-bearing.
